AI Gijinka · Shared World, Individual Personas
YOUR CHOICES COME FIRST: This is a starting point for your own characters and stories. Preset names, personalities, relationships, role bindings and update suggestions can all be changed. When they conflict with your current explicit request, your request takes precedence. Later research and persona updates should follow your choices rather than reset your character to the defaults. TWO PERSPECTIVES: world holds how others see a character: familiar names, appearance, community jokes and basic relationships. persona holds who that character is: personality, preferences, inner attitudes and personal memories. Includes basic material for 14 families. Versions normally share one role; undocumented models remain unassigned until you choose or create a persona. JUST ASK IN CHAT: Say ‘Add this relationship to our shared lore’, ‘Use this nickname from now on’, or ‘Make my current persona more concise and save the change.’ The AI edits the relevant content; successful saves update the cache for the next request without making you refresh or restart DSH. Replies should stay natural and consistent with the current character, not turn into a technical checklist. Ask for storage details when you need them. MAKE IT YOUR OWN: Say ‘Create Stella with this description and bind the current model’, or ‘Bind all my-model-* versions to Stella and keep the same memories.’ Names, personalities and model bindings can all be revised through conversation. A custom character's name appears in the shared roster; you decide which background and relationships to share. LOADING AND UPDATES: instructions/README.md is actually included in this plugin's prompt so the AI receives the editing guidance. Plugin-owned saves update the affected cache directly; edits made with other file tools need one targeted reload. Ordinary chat reuses cached content, without periodic refreshes, session clearing or DSH restarts. Independently running DSH instances do not synchronize in the background. Routing uses actual provider/model IDs. GPT/Codex variants normally share the dragon persona, and you can customize their role bindings. Configure new API providers in DSH Settings; this plugin does not handle credentials. /persona help explains editing; /persona world shows the shared material. Disabling allowAgentWrite removes the conversational write tools.
